title: board.signins: a sign-in the board shows and connects (spec §3.6). The board holds only the proxy's <id>_auth_token; the proxy keeps the vendor's token.

id.description: the connection (or runner-only module) it signs in, and its token <id>_auth_token

status_url.description: the module service's sign-in state; start and finish are its siblings

connect_url.description: the board path that starts the sign-in

callback.description: the board path the vendor returns to (as registered with the vendor)

mode.description: redirect (the default): the vendor sends the browser back to `callback`. device: the proxy's device flow (POST /auth/device): the board shows a code to type on the vendor's page while the proxy waits for the token; `callback` is then never used. qr: the same route, but the proxy answers a link the board shows as a QR code to scan in the vendor's app (it refreshes while pending), and the flow may ask for one transient secret (POST /auth/device/secret, e.g. a password); `callback` is never used

disconnect.description: its service serves POST /auth/disconnect: Connections offers Disconnect, which revokes the sign-in at the vendor

https_only.description: the vendor takes only https redirects (Slack): Connect returns to the board's https address, never the default loopback address the owner pastes back

missing.description: the banner's second sentence before the first sign-in

stopped.description: the banner's second sentence once the sign-in stopped working

when.description: setting: value; asked for only while the module's settings hold

secrets.description: per-install values Connect asks for first, inline (each a secret of this module with `setup:`; compile adds their `fields`): only what can't be a default, such as a company's own address. An entry may carry `when: { <setting>: <value> }`: asked for only in that mode
